articles.title: Architecture — CLI Dispatcher
articles.summary: The CLI dispatcher system in `brain-79` is responsible for parsing global command-line flags and routing user invocations to deterministic CLI subcommands or launching the MCP server fallback.

articles.title: Architecture — MCP Server
articles.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration in `brain-79` enables AI assistants (such as Antigravity, Pi, OpenCode, Claude, Cursor) to interact with repository memory via standard JSON-RPC tools.

articles.title: Architecture — CLI & MCP Symmetry
articles.summary: `brain-79` enforces strict 1:1 symmetry between CLI subcommands and MCP server tools. Any capability available to a human user in the terminal via `brain79 <subcommand>` is equally accessible to an AI agent via `brain79_<tool>()`.

articles.title: Feature — Standalone CLI Interface
articles.summary: The Standalone CLI interface provides 13 deterministic command-line subcommands for managing the repository wiki, executing organizational linter checks, performing handoffs, and initializing memory protocols without requiring an active MCP host connection.

articles.title: Feature — FastMCP Integration
articles.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server feature exposes `brain-79` operations as structured tools over JSON-RPC over stdio, integrating seamlessly with AI clients such as Antigravity, Pi, OpenCode, Claude Desktop, and Cursor.

articles.title: Feature — Short-Term Handoff Continuity
articles.summary: The Short-Term Handoff feature provides tactical transition management between AI development sessions. Unlike long-term wiki knowledge stored in subfolders, handoffs are immutable, timestamped state snapshots stored in `.brain-79/handoffs/handoff-%Y-%m-%d-%H%M%S-%f.md`.

articles.title: Feature — Wiki Organizational Enforcement
articles.summary: The Organizational Enforcement system prevents organic quality degradation of repository wikis. It automatically enforces frontmatter metadata schemas, checks type-location consistency, blocks structural decision leakage in non-decision folders, detects oversized or non-atomic articles, and identifies unfilled template placeholders in `INDEX.md`.

articles.title: Feature — Handoff Purge Operations
articles.summary: `brain79 handoff-purge` provides an explicit operational exception to handoff immutability. It allows developers and agents to clean up tactical short-term handoffs (`.brain-79/handoffs/handoff-*.md`) upon completing sprint iterations, resetting demo repositories, or purging legacy session history.
